assign.outcome:
**The inline problem is smaller than it looks; the vocabulary problem is bigger.** 43% of the 905 inline `.style()` calls set nothing but tokens (`--gap` 273, `--column` 76, `--pad` 65) — the framework's own documented knob. Classified every 7th call (130): only ~27% are a defect. The real gap is three words — `scroll` `stick` `fluid` — that four separate files already invented for themselves (`styles/layouts/space/spec.js:40-42`, and three `specs.js` files re-invented `scroll` independently). Promoting them retires 62 call sites outright.

The other headline: the five-word layout system that shipped 2026-08-17 has **23 call sites** (rail 7, wall 7, stage 9, solo 0) while the string it replaces — `c("page full fill flex v")` — has **40**. `.page.fill` (Page.css:241) and `.page.solo` (Page.css:112) are byte-identical rules under two names. `layouts/doc/css-cost.md:42` already wrote this lesson down about `.basis`: adding a utility retires nothing; converting the call sites does.

Good news the audit did not expect: **zero unlayered CSS files**, one `!important` in production and it is a demo of the bad pattern, and `ui/` is the healthiest tier on the site (19 components, every class prefixed, token-valued, ~15 lines each).
